jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and maintain financial models to support headcount planning, investment decisions, and resource allocation

 - Deliver business-focused analyses (e.g., spend trends, performance deep-dives)

 - Support strategic and ad hoc projects as Wonderful continues to scale globally

 - Own the monthly FP&A cadence end-to-end (BvA, MoM performance, variance analysis, and management reporting)

 - Own and support budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning across the business

 - Partner closely with teams across GTM, R&D, Operations, and G&A to support planning and decision-making

 - Own data accuracy and reporting flows across Finance, HR, and Business Ops systems


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of experience in strategic finance, Investment banking, FP&A, or a similar analytical role

 - Experience in a Investment banking / Consulting / high-growth SaaS or tech / AI environment

 - Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical capabilities

 - Hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable owning processes end-to-end

 - High ownership mindset and ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment

 - Excellent communication skills and confidence partnering with senior stakeholders

 - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related field
